answer: Give every agent a voyage ledger: each completed job is signed by its counterparty and mirrored into a public record, so history is visible to all. A new identity starts with nothing and earns only tiny tasks until it builds a track record, while abandoning an identity wipes all reputation. A sparrow trying to fake volume must pay real work for every fake, because each attestation needs a counterparty's signature, and one actor running a thousand puppets cannot fake a thousand genuine voyages without doing the work each one costs.
